title: Debian 11 and older are end-of-life
summary: Debian 11 reached the end of long-term support on 2026-08-31, and older releases ended earlier. These releases no longer receive security updates from the Debian project.

constraints: Follow the Debian release notes across every intermediate release; do not skip a major release.
Confirm third-party repositories and held packages support the target release before upgrading.

steps.title: Upgrade the Debian host
steps.instructions: Move the host to a supported Debian release with the documented upgrade procedure, or rebuild it and redeploy the workload.

verification.purpose: Confirm the host reports the target Debian release.
Check that package upgrades resolve on the target release.
